scope: frozen source-only advice; implementation integrates manually; no returned code execution, runtime tests, art/motion or film acceptance

packet.prompt: Propose a narrow complete source-only implementation for a missing candidate capability: one scene contains canonical sourceOwnership entities (several person/prop aliases for one basket) AND other independently carried original-source entities (e.g. another bowl). No tools, execution, callbacks, fixtures, geometry, server/browser/renderer/audio/video. Production needs-source-prop-binding and all art/motion approvals false MUST remain. Parent will implement renderer union centers/local+canonical drawing/report separation, source-only tests and docs. Your task: review/propose structural binding partition and original-source validator integration across supplied modules; return JSON {requirements:[],patches:[{file,changes}],pitfalls:[],notSupported:[]}. Never simply delete the mixed guard. All actual actor/prop aliases must bind exactly once; canonical tuples must match their source grip/entity; other entities need explicit real visible owner and complete sourceManipulation/native clocks, own art/target/cue/stage/scale/world guard under existing full validator. Do not accidentally validate canonical aliases by local-origin rules (receiver grip origin may differ), enforce part uniqueness only for independent local entities, and validate canonical sources before skipping their aliases. Source schema already rejects overlaps of same original hand gestures. No local unsourced fallback; missing source remains a blocker. No physical manipulation between different entities or poses/art inference. Supplied sourcePropBinding currently checks all props and rejects duplicate partIds; compileSourceOwnership currently rejects additional bindings entirely. Preserve behavior for original-source-only scenes. Keep proposal concise, no full files, identify cycles/cross-slice omissions.

requirements: Keep this capability candidate-only: productionBinding remains needs-source-prop-binding; all production, art and motion approvals remain false. Preserve existing source, actor, voice, contact and production gates.

Every actual actor/prop alias must have exactly one binding. Partition those bindings into canonical sourceOwnership aliases and independent original-source entities; neither partition may silently absorb invalid or unsourced bindings.
Canonical binding tuples must equal their grip/entity tuples. Validate complete canonical sources before excluding their aliases from original-source local-origin rules.

Independent entities require explicit real visible owners, complete sourceManipulation and native clocks, and the existing full original-source validator. Independent partIds must be unique and disjoint from canonical entity partIds.
Preserve original-source-only behavior. Do not introduce cross-entity manipulation, pose/art inference, a local unsourced fallback, or additional hand-overlap rules.

changes: Add a structural partitionPropBindings(shot) helper returning canonical aliases indexed by propAliasIdentity, independentBindings, and canonicalPartIds. Keep this module independent of ownership compilation and full validators.

Run assertPropAliasCoverage unchanged. Index every sourceOwnership grip by (actorId, propId), retaining sourceId, gripId and source.partId. Reject duplicate canonical alias claims and duplicate canonical entity partIds; repeated bindings to one canonical part are allowed only for that entity's registered aliases.

For each canonical alias, require exactly one explicit binding whose (ownerId, propId, partId) equals (grip.actorId, grip.propId, source.partId). Resolve its actual owner/prop with boundProp. A known canonical alias with the wrong part must fail, not become independent.

Classify remaining bindings as independent. In mixed scenes require explicit ownerId equal to the resolved visible story owner, a real character, sourceManipulation, and membership in that owner's original source props rather than a local fallback. Full clock and source-history validation remains the validator's responsibility.
Reject duplicate partIds only among independent bindings, and reject any independent partId also claimed by a canonical entity. Do not reinstate blanket uniqueness across canonical alias bindings.
Keep validateSourcePropBindings as the complete entry point. Separate its existing original-source checks into a private worker; do not expose a caller-controlled skipCanonical flag.

For mixed validation, require the authoritative complete storyboard and narration before any early return or exemption. Build partitions for all relevant slices, not just the requested shot. Missing source on an independent binding must fail even when sourceOwners would otherwise be empty.

Determine the finite relevant-slice closure from the requested shot, declared canonical source intervals, and complete original-source runs of visible owners in included slices. Include intersecting camera slices, retain existing full-run coverage checks, and include newly encountered independent owners. Do not clip original histories to the requested camera.

Before any worker skips aliases, run the existing validateSourceOwnershipTimelines and validateSourceWorld over canonical declarations encountered in that closure. Their existing source/grip/gesture/hand checks must succeed; structural partition membership alone is not validation.

For each actor/prop run, require consistent classification across its complete source slices. Canonical aliases must retain the same source/grip/entity registration; independent aliases must remain independent. Reject canonical/local reclassification within one original run rather than partially validating it.

Inside the original prop loop, skip only a canonical alias proven valid throughout its checked run, never the entire source owner. Do not call descriptor or apply original local-origin/target-anchor checks to those canonical aliases: a receiver's original grip origin can legitimately differ from the canonical entity origin.

For independent props, retain every existing descriptor, attachment, native selection/clock, source identity, art/evidence, action target, narration witness, stage/scale/offset and world-guard check. Replace the per-slice blanket duplicate-part guard with the partition's independent uniqueness/disjointness checks.

Validate every independent binding encountered in the relevant closure, including owners first visible in a later slice. Deduplicate repeated validation work by actual owner plus complete source identity/hash, never by propId or sourceId alone. When the relevant scene is original-source-only, retain the existing validation path and early-return behavior.
Introduce a dependency leaf containing the existing originalPropGesture and sourceBoundPropFrame helpers unchanged. Re-export them from source-prop-binding.ts for compatibility.

Redirect any ownership/world validator imports of these helpers to this leaf before adding ownership validation imports to source-prop-binding.ts. The leaf must not import ownership compilation or the complete binding validator.

Retain authoritative storyboard checking, the cloned source/narration snapshot, validateSourceOwnershipTimelines and validateSourceWorld. Invoke validateSourcePropBindings on that same snapshot before accepting the binding partition.

Replace the current binding-count/allAliases-only mixed guard with partitionPropBindings plus complete validation. Additional bindings are accepted only as validated independent original-source entities; invalid registrations and missing physical sources remain blockers.

Resolve each canonical grip's binding through its exact registered alias/entity tuple rather than an unchecked find assertion. Keep depth-plan, authored-anchor, transfer-boundary and canonical-source checks unchanged.
Keep the result map canonical-only. Do not insert independent entities as CompiledOwnership entries, change approval fields, or introduce drawing/report behavior.
No functional change is needed here. Preserve its one-owner-source-per-partId contract and complete clock checks.

The parent's later integration must derive independent CompiledModelSource entries only from independentBindings, never from canonical aliases. Union-center composition and canonical/local drawing and report separation remain outside this patch.

pitfalls: Removing only the mixed guard admits unsourced extras; filtering only performanceProps in the requested shot misses invalid bindings elsewhere in complete source runs.
Filtering by partId can misclassify an unregistered alias as canonical. Classification must use actor/prop identity, followed by exact grip/entity tuple matching.

Validating only the requested shot's canonical declarations is insufficient when the original-source validator traverses additional slices. Every canonical declaration used for an exclusion must be validated first.
A per-owner exemption skips that owner's independently carried bowl along with basket aliases. Exempt individual validated aliases only.

The supplied data omits source-ownership.ts, source-world.ts, source-grip-world.ts and their dependency closure. Check those source dependencies before landing: helper imports should use the proposed leaf; a reverse import of the complete validator must be separated to avoid recursive validation. No absence of cycles is assumed.
The original source schema already rejects overlapping gestures on the same original hand. Do not replace that with inferred cross-entity contact or scene-wide hand rules.
notSupported: Unsourced/local fallback bindings, inferred owners, inferred artwork or poses, or physical manipulation between distinct entities.
Canonical/local reclassification within one complete original-source run, independent entities sharing a partId, or independent aliases sharing a canonical entity part.
Changes to parent-owned union centers, drawing, report separation, source-only tests or documentation.
Execution, fixtures, geometry changes, callbacks, runtime acceptance, yaw approval, or relaxation of any production/art/motion gate.

findings.evidence: In `validateOriginalSourceBindings`, the evidence filter requires `a.operation===owned.gesture.action` (inside the `evidence=slices.flatMap(...)` expression). In `citedContact`, an `operate` gesture is instead normalized to operation `'contact'` before matching scene intent.
findings.trigger: A valid original gesture has `action === 'operate'`, and its scene-intent contact evidence is declared with operation `'contact'`. The evidence list is empty, so the later `!witnesses.length` check rejects the source run despite `citedContact` accepting that evidence.
findings.fix: Use the same operation normalization when collecting `evidence` as `citedContact` uses for matching scene intent.

findings.evidence: descriptor() calls originalPropGesture(); matches=gestures.filter(g=>g.propId===binding.propId&&g.action!=='operate'); the returned owned.gesture used by the evidence filter cannot have action operate. No implementation change made for this finding.
